title: Evidence record, format 1 (quality spec #evidence-store, docs/adr/0025): one drive of a declared demo, record.json in the target's evidence store
description: Written by octo-feather-evidence append, never rewritten. No key or value names a path on this box (#evidence-portable): output names are relative to the drive's evidence folder, the target is keyed by its root commit.

format.description: This record's format version: picks schemas/evidence.v<format>.schema.json

id.description: The record's id, unique in its store: <UTC time>-<8 hex>, e.g. 20261027T031500Z-a1b2c3d4

target.description: The target's key, as octo-feather-evidence --help defines it

revision.description: The code revision driven: the full HEAD commit at append time

dirty.description: True when tracked files differed from revision at append time (git status shows modified, staged or untracked files), so the drive ran code revision does not name

id.description: <spec>#<anchor>, the spec's file stem and the criterion's anchor

text_sha256.description: sha256 of the criterion's text (UTF-8, white space runs collapsed to one space, trimmed)

text_from.description: spec: the element with that anchor in the target's docs/specs/<spec>.spec.html; caller: the caller's copy (--criterion-text), as the target has no such spec

contract.description: The app-driver contract the drive read: qc.toml's format and the sha256 of its bytes; null when the target has no qc.toml

fixture.description: The fixtures' version: sha256 over each fixture qc.toml declares (sorted by name: name, reset command, and the content of its path when it declares one, at append time); null when it declares none

outputs.description: The captured outputs, by name relative to the drive's evidence folder; each file's copy is outputs/<name> beside record.json

time.description: When the record was appended, UTC, ISO 8601 to the second
